english_source: A 3-passage joint is specified for "gripper, vacuum, and blow-off." But the integrator routes vacuum and blow-off through the same channel to save a passage. The result: when blow-off pulses at 0.3 MPa, it back-feeds into the vacuum line, momentarily destroying holding force. Parts drop. The customer blames the gripper. Rule: Every pneumatic function gets its own independent passage. Vacuum, positive pressure, and blow-off must never share a channel. The cost of one extra passage is negligible compared to a dropped-part incident.

english_source: A 3-passage joint is specified for "gripper, vacuum, and blow-off." But the integrator routes vacuum and blow-off through the same channel to save a passage. The result: when blow-off pulses at 0.3 MPa, it back-feeds into the vacuum line, momentarily destroying holding force. Parts drop. The customer blames the gripper. Rule: Every pneumatic function gets its own independent passage. Vacuum, positive pressure, and blow-off must never share a channel. The cost of one extra passage is negligible compared to a dropped-part incident.

english_source: A machine builder needs three different air pressures for clamp, blow-off, and vacuum on a rotary table. They buy BP-2P-0002 and install regulators on each outlet.
